rv.q: As the central characters, Smith and Ismael Garcia (as Yitzhak) are smoldering coals. Each interaction builds up its fiery potential until suddenly we're engulfed.
I would definitely recommend this production of Hedwig.
Happily, Haven Chicago's new production delivers the goods.
Smith, with a perfect singing voice for the part, plays Hedwig as an unexploded bomb, always seeming to straddle the line between breaking down in tears and breaking props in anger.
